senses.gloss: f. (preced.) cord, esp. spinal column; skeleton (interch. with שִׁדְרָה); trnsf. stem, rib of a plant.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:1:8">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> top <he>מציינין על הש׳ וכ׳</he> you must mark the spot as unclean if you find a spinal column or a skull.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:2:3">Y. Taan. II, 65ᶜ</cite> top <he>כנגד … שבש׳</he> corresponding to the eighteen vertebræ of the spinal column.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:1:2">Y. Succ. III, 53ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>לולב … ש׳</he> the Lulab must be a handbreadth high, not counting the stem; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שִׁזְרוֹת</he>, <cite ref="U00069"><he>שִׁי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:9:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שהראשים והש׳ וכ׳</he> (fish-brine) in which the heads and the spines are intact; (Bab.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1:6">Y. Sabb. III, beg. 5ᶜ</cite> <he>שִׁיזְרֵי חריות</he> stems of dry twigs (prob. to be read: <he>שִׁיּוּרֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="H01675"><he>חֶרְיָה</he></cite>).
